text: (You wake up in a dark and humid cabin in the middle of nowhere.)
(As you try to remember how you got here, a few things start coming back to you.)
(You remember coming to this cabin to investigate something strange that has been happening inside it.)
(But now that you're here, it seems that whatever this power is, it's messing with your memory.)
(As you try to remember more, a TV suddenly turns on behind you.)
(No one is there. Just a lonely TV in the middle of the cabin.)
(You stare at the TV for a bit, but the static on the screen starts making your head hurt.)
(Maybe this is what you came looking for, you think to yourself.)
(You don't like this situation at all, but it's probably best to keep investigating.)
(You pick up a controller lying near the TV.)
